rows.text: The Bureau of Experts record names the instrument as Royal Order A/91 of 27/8/1412 AH and prints the issue date 1412/08/27 AH, equal to 01/03/1992, and the publication date 1412/09/02 AH, equal to 06/03/1992. It marks the law as in force (ساري).
rows.locator: Law summary panel (تاريخ الإصدار، تاريخ النشر، الحالة، أدوات إصدار النظام)

rows.text: The order's clauses issue the law in the attached form; replace the Shura Council law of 1347 AH and provide that the Council's arrangements are settled by royal order; keep existing laws in force until amended; apply the law within at most six months of its publication; and publish it in the official gazette.
rows.locator: Royal Order A/91, clauses First to Fifth

rows.text: The original Article 3 provides for a Chairman and sixty members chosen by the King. The record's amendment notes cite Royal Order A/26 of 1426/3/2 AH (a Chairman and 150 members) and A/44 of 1434/2/29 AH (women at least 20 per cent).

rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Article 10: the Chairman of the Shura Council, his deputy and the Secretary-General are appointed and relieved by royal orders, which also set their ranks, rights, duties and affairs. An amendment by Royal Order A/181 of 14/12/1428 AH adds the Assistant Chairman.

rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Article 11: the Chairman, the members and the Secretary-General take the prescribed oath before the King before they begin their work in the Council.

Article 13: the Council's term is four Hijri years from the date specified in the royal order forming it; a new council is formed at least two months before its predecessor's term ends, the old council continues if the term ends first, and at least half the members of a new council must be new.
